bio: Hi there, I'm a senior CS student at Drexel seeking 2027 full-time roles in full-stack SWE, forward deployed engineering, ML engineering, and product management.
I build at the intersection of software, AI, and product, with experience in full-stack development, backend APIs, computer vision, VLM research, and AI prototypes.
I've joined 20+ hackathons at schools including Stanford, MIT, UPenn, and Columbia, winning 7 awards.

publication.title: DrawSim-PD: Simulating Student Science Drawings to Support NGSS-Aligned Teacher Diagnostic Reasoning
publication.abstract: AI-powered system that helps educators analyze student science drawings and accelerate classroom feedback loops. End-to-end applied AI workflow — data, model inference, and user-facing output.

projects.title: Phillynet Nexus
projects.description: an ai-powered dashboard that predicts where connectivity complaints will spike across philadelphia's 53 zip codes. combines fcc broadband data, ookla speed measurements, census demographics, and 311 complaint history to give internet providers and city planners a heads-up.

projects.title: Tickermaster
projects.description: a sandbox of financial AI agents that lets you test strategies, learn trading fundamentals, and understand sentiment-driven moves before placing real orders. features live research with market data and social sentiment, multi-agent trading simulations, and watchlist tracking with AI broker support.
